versions.label: V1 · original fungal reference
versions.description: Original FN812768.2 reference, captured UNITE catalog, eight mapped pairs and pilot landmarks. Taxonomic class and clade are unresolved.

versions.label: V2 · NCBI fungal reference panel
versions.description: Bounded NCBI fungal rDNA reference panel with frozen accession taxonomy, alignment, landmark evidence and exact primer-site results.

versions.label: V3 · LSU domains and partial genes
versions.description: Sequences, alignment, catalog and primer results are unchanged from v2-2b629f0f2fe8; reviewed LSU domain annotations and their source evidence are frozen in this version.
